languageHelp: The language Marquee is shown in for your account, on every device. Notifications you get are written in it too.
languageInvalid: Choose one of the languages in the list.
ssoLinked: {name} is linked. You can sign in with it now.
linkedAccountsIntro: Sign in with the account you use for the household's media server or single sign-on.
traktListsIntro: Request what's added to your public Trakt watchlist or lists.
notificationsIntro: Requests approved or declined, and titles ready to watch, on this device.
appearanceIntro: How Marquee looks on this device.
householdMembersIntro: Everyone with an account on this Marquee instance.
yourAccountIntro: Edit your name, username, or password below.
addMemberIntro: There's no public signup page — create accounts for other people in your household here.
importIntro: Add the people you already share your server with. They sign in with that account — no password to hand out.
blocklistIntro: Titles and keywords nobody can request. Block a single title from its page, or use the automatic rules below to block by age rating or TMDb's adult flag.
menuPositionHelp: Where the menu sits on this device, on larger screens. On a phone-sized window the menu is always a tab bar along the bottom.
blocklistEmpty: Nothing blocked. Block a title from its page, or a keyword below.
blockKeywordHelp: Any title with this TMDb keyword or genre can't be requested (you can still add it yourself).
accountCreated: Account created — they can now sign in at <path>{path}</path>.
onlyAdminAddsMembers: Only the admin can add household members.
onlyAdminRemovesMembers: Only the admin can remove household members.
photoSaveFailed: Couldn't save the photo. Try again.
serverUnreachable: Couldn't reach the server. Try again.
photoHelp: Kept on this server and shown in the menu and the apps.
newPasswordKeepPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep current password
currentPasswordPlaceholder: Needed only when setting a new password
requestLimitsLegend: Request limits (blank for none; not for someone with No request limits)
presetTrustedOption: Trusted — also reviews requests and problem reports
permAdminOnlyNote: Settings, integrations, household accounts, API keys and sign-in stay yours alone.
permRequestMoviesHelp: Ask for movies to be added.
permRequestTvHelp: Ask for shows, or some of their seasons, to be added.
permRequest4kMoviesHelp: Ask for the 4K copy of a movie, once there's a 4K Radarr.
permRequest4kTvHelp: Ask for the 4K copy of a show, once there's a 4K Sonarr.
permAdvancedRequestsHelp: Pick the server, quality profile, folder and tags when asking for or approving a title.
permBypassLimitsHelp: Request limits don't apply to them.
permAutoApproveMoviesHelp: Their movie requests skip the review queue.
permAutoApproveTvHelp: Their TV requests skip the review queue.
permAutoApprove4kMoviesHelp: Their 4K movie requests skip the review queue.
permAutoApprove4kTvHelp: Their 4K TV requests skip the review queue.
permViewRequestsHelp: The Requests page lists what everyone has asked for.
permReviewRequestsHelp: Approve, decline and change other people's requests, and handle Can't find and Couldn't add.
permManageIssuesHelp: See everyone's problem reports and mark them fixed.
permReportIssuesHelp: Tell you when something's wrong with a title.
importedMembers: {count, plural, one {Added # household member.} other {Added # household members.}}
importDialogHelp: Each person gets a member account and signs in with {server}.
importNobody: Nobody else has access to your {server} server.
mediaServerSignupHelp: Anyone who can use your server gets a member account the first time they sign in, including anyone you remove here, who can come straight back. The sign-in screen tells newcomers to sign in that way. Off: only the people you import (or who link their account) can sign in that way.
waitingForPlex: Waiting for Plex… finish in the tab that opened.
plexStartFailed: Couldn't start Plex sign-in. Try again.
plexTimedOut: Timed out waiting for Plex sign-in. Try again.
plexExpired: That Plex sign-in expired. Try again.
enterJellyfinCredentials: Enter your Jellyfin username and password.
ssoNotSetUp: Single sign-on isn't set up on this server.
ssoWrongHost: Open Marquee at {url} to link {name} — that's the address {name} sends you back to.
onlyAdminSignInSettings: Only the admin can change sign-in settings.
onlyAdminHouseholdChannels: Only the admin can change the household channels.
checkedMomentAgo: Checked a moment ago. Try again in a minute.
watchlistHelp: New movies and shows you add to your Watchlist on Plex are requested for you, the same as pressing Request. Marquee keeps a Plex sign-in for this until you turn it off.
watchlistRequestedSoFar: {count, plural, one {# title requested so far} other {# titles requested so far}}
pushTestSent: {count, plural, one {Sent to # device. It should appear in a moment.} other {Sent to # devices. It should appear in a moment.}}
pushTestNothing: Nothing was delivered. Check that notifications are on for this device.
pushInsecure: Not available here: browsers only allow notifications on a site opened over https. Open Marquee through your https address (a reverse proxy) to turn them on.
pushIosHomeScreen: On iPhone and iPad, add Marquee to your Home Screen (Share, then Add to Home Screen) and open it from there to turn notifications on.
pushUnsupported: This browser doesn't support notifications from websites.
pushBlocked: Blocked for this site. Allow notifications in the browser's site settings, then turn them on here.
pushHelp: Sent by your Marquee server itself, encrypted so only this device can read them. The Mac and Windows apps show notifications on their own while they're open.
traktHelp: New movies and shows added to a public Trakt watchlist or list are requested for you every few hours, the same as pressing Request.
traktRequestExisting: Also request what's on it now
traktNotConnected: Trakt isn't connected on this server yet. The admin can connect it in Settings → General.
traktSyncGone: That Trakt sync doesn't exist any more.
yourChannelsIntro: Get your notifications on Telegram, Pushover, email, Discord, ntfy or a webhook. Only you can see these.
noChannels: No channels yet. Add one below.
whatYouHearAboutIntro: Choose where each kind of notification goes. The bell is the list at the top of every page; devices are the browsers, Macs and PCs you turned notifications on for.
channelTestSent: Sent. It should arrive in a moment.
channelConfirmed: Confirmed. Notifications will go to this address.
codeSentTelegram: The bot sent a 6-digit code to your Telegram chat.
newCodeSent: A new code is on its way.
telegramChatIdHintBot: Message {bot} /start, then paste your chat ID (@userinfobot on Telegram tells you yours). Or use Connect with Telegram above.
telegramChatIdHint: Message the household's bot /start, then paste your chat ID (@userinfobot on Telegram tells you yours).
pushoverUserKeyHint: The 30-character key at the top of your pushover.net dashboard.
emailHint: We'll email a code to confirm it's yours first.
discordWebhookHint: In your own server: channel settings › Integrations › Webhooks › New Webhook › Copy Webhook URL.
ntfyTopicHint: On {server}. Subscribe to the same topic in the ntfy app.
webhookHintInternet: Marquee POSTs JSON: {shape}. It must be on the internet, not your home network.
checkInbox: Check your inbox for the code.
checkTelegram: Check Telegram: the bot sent you a code to enter above.
channelAdded: Added. A test message is on its way.
telegramStartFailed: Couldn't start. Enter your chat ID instead.
telegramConnected: Telegram connected. A test message is on its way.
telegramQuickest: Quickest: open the household's bot, {bot}, press Start, and come back. Marquee finds your chat by itself.
ntfyHouseholdTopic: A topic on the household's server
channelsNotSetUp: {count, plural, one {{channels} can be added once the admin sets it up for the household.} other {{channels} can be added once the admin sets them up for the household.}}
eventRequestStillLooking: Still looking for something I asked for
eventIssueUpdated: A problem I reported is fixed
eventRequestComment: Comments on requests and problem reports
eventTitleShared: Someone shares a title with me
menuLabelsHelp: Names beside the menu's icons, and the server's version at the end.
profileRequestSplit: {movies, plural, one {# movie} other {# movies}} · {series} series
accountPageIntro: Your profile, how you sign in, and how Marquee looks on this device.
photoRowHelp: Shown in the menu and the apps. Change it under Your account, below.
signOutHelp: Signs you out of Marquee in this browser.
generalIntro: Where Marquee gets its movie and TV details, API keys for other apps, and moving over from Seerr.
mediaServersIntro: Connect Plex or Jellyfin so Marquee knows what the household already owns. Credentials are stored encrypted on your server.
notificationsPageIntro: Your own notifications, and the channels the whole household hears from.
updateAvailableHelp: Update your server by pulling the new Docker image (on Unraid: Docker › Check for Updates, then apply it).
updateCurrentHelp: This server runs the newest release.
updateUnknownHelp: Couldn't check GitHub for a newer release just now.
testPassed: It works. Save to keep it.
testSent: It works — a test message is on its way. Save to keep it.
autoBlockHelp: Every title that matches can't be requested — you can still add it yourself. Preview shows what it would catch among the titles Marquee has looked up.
autoBlockAdultOn: Already blocked — remove it from the list above to allow it again.
autoBlockRatingHelp: As TMDb lists it for that country: NC-17, TV-MA, 18…
blockPreviewSummary: {matched, plural, =0 {Nothing among the {scanned} titles Marquee has looked up.} one {Would block # of the {scanned} titles Marquee has looked up.} other {Would block # of the {scanned} titles Marquee has looked up.}}
blockPreviewPending: {count, plural, one {# request waiting for review is for one of them.} other {# requests waiting for review are for these.}}
slackWebhookHint: From Slack's Incoming Webhooks app, or Mattermost's or Rocket.Chat's.
pushbulletTokenHint: On pushbullet.com, Settings › Account › Create access token.
pushbulletChannelHint: Leave blank to push to all your devices.
